_meta.title: The Debt & The Plumbing — figures
_meta.units: Dollar amounts are in billions of USD unless a figure's `unit` says otherwise. Rates are percent per year.

status_legend.primary: Read directly from the named primary source (API, release or document).
status_legend.secondary: Taken from a secondary site (aggregator, news, research note) that cites the primary source. Must be checked against the primary before publishing.
status_legend.derived: Computed in this file from other figures. The `formula` field shows how.
status_legend.modeled: An approximation built by a script in /scripts. Not a published number.
status_legend.recall: A well-known historical figure entered from memory. Needs checking against the source.

_meta.access_note: First compiled 2026-11-03 from web-search excerpts while primary hosts were blocked. Re-checked the same day against the primary APIs and documents (Fiscal Data API, H.4.1 HTML, FRED, NY Fed markets API) once access was granted. 'primary' now means read directly from the source. Still unreachable: ticdata.treasury.gov, home.treasury.gov, newyorkfed.org (non-API pages), ici.org, financialresearch.gov, issuer sites (Tether, Circle). Update 2026-11-04: ticdata.treasury.gov and home.treasury.gov are now reachable (TIC is primary). www.newyorkfed.org, www.ici.org and www.financialresearch.gov are still refused by the proxy (403 on CONNECT). Update 2026-11-04 (later): www.newyorkfed.org and www.financialresearch.gov now reachable; NY Fed markets API used for SOFR volume. www.ici.org answers 403 itself (bot protection; not bypassed). Still refused by proxy: data.financialresearch.gov, www.sec.gov, tether.to, www.circle.com.

totalPublicDebt.label: Total public debt outstanding (gross)
totalPublicDebt.source: Treasury MSPD Table I (Fiscal Data API mspd_table_1)

debtHeldByPublic.label: Debt held by the public
debtHeldByPublic.note: Includes the Federal Reserve's holdings. The Fed counts as 'the public' in Treasury accounting.

intragovernmental.label: Intragovernmental holdings (trust funds etc.)
intragovernmental.note: Mostly non-marketable Government Account Series securities held by Social Security, Medicare, federal pension and other trust funds.

totalPublicDebtLatest.label: Total public debt outstanding, latest daily
totalPublicDebtLatest.source: Treasury, Debt to the Penny (Fiscal Data API)
totalPublicDebtLatest.note: Down from $40,593.6bn on Oct 29: daily debt dips around month-end redemptions and trust-fund flows.

totalPublicDebtOct16.label: Total public debt outstanding
totalPublicDebtOct16.note: Used with the Oct 29 figure to set the counter's growth rate.

dailyGrowthEstimate.label: Average daily increase in gross debt, trailing ~3 months (estimate)
dailyGrowthEstimate.formula: (40502.081 - 39739.223) / 91 days (Aug 3 → Nov 2 2026, Debt to the Penny)
dailyGrowthEstimate.note: Debt moves in steps, not smoothly: jumps on settlement days, dips at month-ends. Shorter windows give anything from ~8 to ~15 bn/day. Show only as a labeled estimate.

nonMarketableTotal.label: Total non-marketable debt
nonMarketableTotal.note: Government Account Series: 7,726.3 held by trust funds, 367.96 by the public (e.g. Thrift Savings Plan G Fund-type accounts).

debtLimit.label: Statutory debt limit
debtLimit.source: Treasury, Daily Treasury Statement Table III-C (statutory limit set by P.L. 119-21, Jul 4 2025)

debtSubjectToLimit.label: Debt subject to limit
debtSubjectToLimit.source: Treasury, Daily Treasury Statement Table III-C (Fiscal Data API)
debtSubjectToLimit.formula: total public debt 40,502.081 − debt not subject to limit (0.474 + 191.741 + 3.591)
debtSubjectToLimit.note: Headroom under the $41,103.996bn limit: $797.7bn on Nov 2 2026. Excluded from the limit: mainly unamortized discount on bills and zero-coupon bonds, plus Federal Financing Bank debt.

dailyGrowthPublic.label: Average daily increase in debt held by the public, trailing ~3 months (estimate)
dailyGrowthPublic.formula: (32719.902 - 32038.116) / 91 days (Aug 3 → Nov 2 2026, Debt to the Penny)

composition._note: Marketable debt by instrument, Sep 30 2026, from MSPD Table I and Treasury Average Interest Rates (both via Fiscal Data API).

bills.label: Bills
bills.source: Treasury MSPD Table I; rate: Treasury Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)
bills.note: 22.36% of marketable debt, above the 15–20% range TBAC recommends.

notes.label: Notes (2–10y)
notes.source: Treasury MSPD Table I; rate: Treasury Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)

bonds.label: Bonds (20–30y)
bonds.source: Treasury MSPD Table I; rate: Treasury Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)

tips.label: TIPS
tips.source: Treasury MSPD Table I; rate: Treasury Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)
tips.note: Includes inflation compensation. The rate is the real coupon, not counting the inflation adjustment to principal.

frn.label: Floating-rate notes
frn.source: Treasury MSPD Table I; rate: Treasury Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)

avgRateMarketable.label: Average interest rate, marketable debt
avgRateMarketable.source: Treasury, Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)

avgRateAllInterestBearing.label: Average interest rate, all interest-bearing debt
avgRateAllInterestBearing.source: Treasury, Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)

avgRateMarketable2022.label: Average interest rate, marketable debt, all-time low
avgRateMarketable2022.source: Treasury, Average Interest Rates (Fiscal Data API)
avgRateMarketable2022.note: The 1.56% I recalled earlier was wrong.

weightedAvgMaturity.label: Weighted average maturity of marketable debt
weightedAvgMaturity.source: JEC Monthly Debt Update; GAO-26-107529 gives 71 months for Sep 2025

shareMaturingWithin12m.label: Share of marketable debt maturing within 12 months
shareMaturingWithin12m.formula: Σ outstanding with maturity Oct 2026–Sep 2027 ÷ marketable total, from MSPD Table III (data/maturities.json)
shareMaturingWithin12m.note: GAO-26-107529 reports 33% for Sep 2025 (secondary; files.gao.gov unreachable).

couponsMaturingNext12m.label: Fixed-rate notes & bonds maturing Oct 2026 – Sep 2027
couponsMaturingNext12m.note: dollarliquidity.com reported $2,950bn at 2.98%, consistent. TIPS + FRNs in the same window: $575.8bn (MSPD).
couponsMaturingNext12m.formula: notes + bonds maturing Oct 2026–Sep 2027, MSPD Table III (scripts/build-maturities-mspd.mjs)

deficitFY2026.label: Federal deficit, FY2026
deficitFY2026.source: Treasury, Final Monthly Treasury Statement FY2026

netInterestFY2026.label: Net interest outlays, FY2026
netInterestFY2026.source: Treasury, Final MTS FY2026 (Net Outlays table)
netInterestFY2026.note: Net = gross interest on Treasury debt minus interest received by trust funds and other interest income. FY2025 was about $970bn.

grossInterestFY2026.label: Gross interest expense on Treasury debt, FY2026
grossInterestFY2026.source: Treasury, Interest Expense on the Debt Outstanding (Fiscal Data API)
grossInterestFY2026.note: Gross includes interest paid to trust funds (the government paying itself). Fiscal year to Jul 31: $1,170.0bn, which confirms the "$1.17T in 10 months" figure.

netInterestShareOutlays.label: Net interest as share of total outlays, FY2026

cboNetInterest.label: CBO projected net interest
cboNetInterest.source: CBO, The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2026 to 2036 (Feb 2026)
cboNetInterest.note: Share of outlays: 13.9% (2026) → 18.8% (2036), derived. CBO: rising average interest rates account for about half the increase. Read via a search excerpt; the host was unreachable from this environment, so not opened directly.

primaryDeficitFY2026.label: Primary deficit, FY2026 (deficit excluding net interest)

fed._note: H.4.1 release of Oct 29 2026, Table 5 (consolidated statement of condition), Wednesday level Oct 28 2026. Read directly from federalreserve.gov. These are the starting state for the balance-sheet identity in the flow map.

somaMBS.label: Fed agency MBS
somaMBS.note: Down $186bn over the year. Principal is reinvested into T-bills (Dec 2025 policy).

reserves.label: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks
reserves.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1, Table 5 ("Other deposits held by depository institutions")
reserves.note: Down $74.3bn on the week as the TGA rose $70.5bn. Week average: 2,893.8 (FRED WRESBAL).

tga.label: Treasury General Account (TGA)
tga.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1, Table 5; same as the Daily Treasury Statement closing balance
tga.note: History from the Daily Treasury Statement (Fiscal Data API).

onRrp.label: Overnight reverse repo (ON RRP) facility usage

currency.label: Currency in circulation (Federal Reserve notes, net)
currency.note: Up $66.8bn year on year. (FRED WCURCIR, $2,484.5bn, is a broader "currency in circulation" that includes coin; the identity uses the H.4.1 Table 5 line.)

otherLiabilitiesAndCapital.label: Other deposits, other liabilities & capital (net of deferred asset)
otherLiabilitiesAndCapital.note: "Other liabilities" is negative because it includes the deferred asset (−$232.5bn). "Other deposits" includes GSE and designated-utility accounts. All values read from Table 5; the identity balances to within $0.001bn.

totalAssetsPeak.label: Fed total assets, all-time peak
totalAssetsPeak.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1 via FRED WALCL

deferredAsset.label: Fed deferred asset (earnings remittances due, negative)
deferredAsset.note: Table 6 shows it by Reserve Bank; the New York Fed accounts for $134.2bn of it. July 2026 Monetary Policy Report: ~$236bn; peak above $245bn in Jan 2026. CBO expects material remittances again by ~2031.

qtStatus.label: Balance-sheet policy
qtStatus.value: QT ended Dec 1 2025; T-bill purchases since Dec 12 2025, slowing to ~$13bn/month by Oct 2026
qtStatus.source: NY Fed Treasury operations; FOMC implementation notes
qtStatus.note: The Dec 2025 start of bill purchases and their monthly sizes are verified against NY Fed operation results. The Dec 1 2025 end date of QT is from FOMC implementation notes read via search excerpts.

otherAssets.label: Other Fed assets
otherAssets.note: From H.4.1 Table 5. Gold, SDR and coin taken as the remainder.

billPurchases.label: Fed T-bill purchases (reserve management + MBS reinvestment)
billPurchases.note: Sum Dec 2025–Oct 2026. These figures cover both reserve-management purchases and reinvested MBS principal, which the operation results do not separate. Small "coupon sales" ($25–75M) in the same feed are routine test operations.

policy_rates._note: Set by the Oct 28 2026 FOMC (hold, 10–2; two dissents favored a hike). The Sep 16 2026 meeting raised the range 25bp — the first hike since 2023 — under Chair Warsh.

ffTargetLow.label: Fed funds target range, lower bound

ffTargetHigh.label: Fed funds target range, upper bound

srfRate.label: Standing repo operations minimum bid rate (ceiling)
srfRate.note: The facility has been renamed from Standing Repo Facility (SRF) to standing repo operations (SRP).

sofr.label: SOFR
sofr.note: 5bp above IORB (3.90%), a sign reserves are near the low end of "ample".

market_yields._note: Treasury par yield curve via FRED (H.15), Nov 2 2026.

y3m.label: 3-month bill
y3m.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS3MO
y3m.note: Above the top of the fed funds range (4.00%), so the bill market is pricing at least one more hike.

y2.label: 2-year
y2.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS2

y5.label: 5-year
y5.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS5

y10.label: 10-year
y10.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS10

y20.label: 20-year
y20.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS20

y30.label: 30-year
y30.source: Treasury par yield curve via FRED DGS30

holders._note: Who owns the debt. Domestic sectors come from the Fed's Financial Accounts (Z.1) for Q2 2026 (via FRED), on Z.1's basis: Treasury securities held by the public, $31.49T. The Fed figure is updated from H.4.1. Trust funds come from MSPD. The UI must label which base it uses.

fed.label: Federal Reserve (SOMA)
fed.note: Z.1 Q2 2026 gives $4,082.7bn for the Fed; H.4.1 on Jun 24 2026 should be compared to see whether the gap is inflation compensation and timing (TODO).

foreignByCountry.label: Major foreign holders of Treasury securities
foreignByCountry.source: Treasury TIC, Table 5: Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities
foreignByCountry.note: TIC records where a security is held (custody), not who ultimately owns it. The UK, Belgium, Luxembourg and Cayman Islands partly reflect custodians and hedge funds. Official (central banks and governments) = 40.2% of the total.

mmfTotalAssets.label: Money market fund total assets
mmfTotalAssets.source: ICI weekly Money Market Fund Assets
mmfTotalAssets.note: Z.1 puts money funds' Treasury holdings at $3,281.6bn (Q2 2026); the rest of their assets is mostly repo.

tetherTBills.label: Tether T-bill holdings
tetherTBills.source: Tether quarterly attestation (via Motley Fool excerpt)
tetherTBills.note: Another source says ~$141bn total Treasury exposure, which probably includes reverse repo. Attestation date unconfirmed.

usdcSupply.label: USDC supply
usdcSupply.note: Most of Circle's reserves (~84% as of Jun 30) sit in the Circle Reserve Fund, a government MMF run by BlackRock.

z1Total.label: Treasury securities held by the public (Z.1 basis)

bySector.label: Domestic holders by sector
bySector.source: Fed Financial Accounts Z.1, Table L.210 (via FRED)
bySector.note: Z.1's household sector is a residual and includes hedge funds, so "households" overstates what individuals hold. Sectors not listed (credit unions, other financial firms, nonfinancial corporations, GSEs, etc.) make up the remainder.

bankDeposits.label: Deposits at all commercial banks
bankDeposits.source: Federal Reserve H.8 via FRED DPSACBW027SBOG (seasonally adjusted)

fedSep30.label: Fed Treasury holdings, Sep 30 2026
fedSep30.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1 via FRED WSHOTSL

mmfTotalAssetsZ1.label: Money market funds: total financial assets (Z.1)
mmfTotalAssetsZ1.source: Fed Financial Accounts Z.1 via FRED MMMFFAQ027S
mmfTotalAssetsZ1.note: Quarterly and broader than ICI's weekly figure (includes all money fund assets on Z.1 basis). ICI weekly ($7.9T, Oct 28) remains secondary.

repoMarketSize.label: US repo market, total outstanding exposures
repoMarketSize.note: Treasury repo ≈ $8.8T of this. A Sep 2026 Wolf Street piece uses $13.5T. These are outstanding positions, not daily turnover.

sofrVolume.label: SOFR underlying daily volume
sofrVolume.note: SOFR covers tri-party, GCF and FICC-cleared bilateral repo. BGCR (tri-party + GCF) was $1,250bn, so cleared bilateral ≈ $2,018bn (derived). A quarter of SOFR volume traded at or above 4.00%, the standing repo rate.

hedgeFundRepoBorrowing.label: Hedge fund repo borrowing (gross)
hedgeFundRepoBorrowing.note: All hedge-fund repo, not just basis trades. OFR estimated the basis trade itself at ~$2T at end-2025.

srfSep2026QuarterEnd.label: Standing repo take-up at Sep 30 2026 quarter-end
srfSep2026QuarterEnd.note: Near zero on Mar 31 and Jun 30 2026. Usage collapsed after RMPs began.

geniusAct.label: GENIUS Act signed
geniusAct.note: Reserves must be 1:1 in: coins and currency; demand deposits; Treasury bills, notes or bonds with ≤93 days remaining maturity; repurchase agreements (maturity ≤7 days, overnight preferred) backed by such Treasury bills; government MMFs investing only in these; central bank reserve deposits. Agencies had to finalize rules by Jul 18 2026. Effective by Jan 18 2027 at the latest (or 120 days after final rules). OCC final rule: Bulletin 2026-50 (Oct 2026). Read via a search excerpt; the host was unreachable from this environment, so not opened directly.

eslr.label: eSLR reform final rule
eslr.note: Effective Apr 1 2026, with early adoption allowed from Jan 1 2026. Replaces the fixed 2% eSLR buffer for G-SIB holding companies with one tied to each bank's G-SIB surcharge (half of method 1). Frees balance sheet for dealers to hold and finance Treasuries. Read via a search excerpt; the host was unreachable from this environment, so not opened directly.

clearingMandate.label: SEC Treasury central clearing mandate
clearingMandate.note: Read via a search excerpt; the host was unreachable from this environment, so not opened directly.

jgb10y.label: Japan 10-year JGB yield
jgb10y.note: Crossed 3% on Sep 1 2026 for the first time since 1996. Peaked ≈3.12% intraday Oct 1/6. 30y record 4.235% on Oct 5.

swapLines.label: Standing dollar swap lines
swapLines.value: Bank of Canada, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, ECB, Swiss National Bank
swapLines.source: Federal Reserve, Central bank liquidity swaps

jgb10yMonthly.label: Japan 10-year government bond yield (monthly average)
jgb10yMonthly.source: OECD Main Economic Indicators via FRED IRLTLT01JPM156N

countryCompare.label: US, Japan and UK compared
countryCompare.source: IMF World Economic Outlook (debt) and OECD (10-year yields) via FRED
countryCompare.note: General government gross debt (all levels of government, IMF definition, so the US figure is higher than federal debt held by the public). Yields are monthly averages. Average maturity of each country's debt (UK gilts are much longer-dated than US Treasuries) is not included: it needs the UK Debt Management Office and Japan's Ministry of Finance, which were not reachable.

history_anchors._note: Used for the 'then vs now' notes and the future historical scrubber. All of these are from memory and must be checked.

couponMix.label: Nominal coupon auction sizes per month (average of new issues and reopenings)
couponMix.source: Treasury auction results (Fiscal Data API, auctions_query), Aug–Oct 2026
couponMix.note: 10y: $42bn new issue, $39bn reopenings; 20y: $16bn / $13bn; 30y: $25bn / $22bn. Plus 2-year FRNs ($28–30bn/month) and TIPS. Confirmed unchanged for Nov 2026–Jan 2027 in the Nov 4 2026 refunding statement (sb0678).

recentAuctionYields.label: Recent auction high yields
recentAuctionYields.note: Yields peaked in early October 2026 (same week as the JGB 30y record) and fell back by Nov 2 (10y 4.91%).

borrowingEstimates.label: Privately-held net marketable borrowing estimates
borrowingEstimates.source: Treasury press release sb0675, "Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates" (Nov 2 2026)
borrowingEstimates.note: Excludes SOMA rollovers. Auction sizes were confirmed unchanged in the Nov 4 2026 refunding statement (sb0678).

auctionStats.label: Recent coupon auction results
auctionStats.source: Treasury auction results (Fiscal Data API, auctions_query)
auctionStats.note: USD bn accepted. Indirect bidders are mostly foreign central banks and investors bidding through dealers; direct bidders bid for their own account. Totals include SOMA add-ons where applicable.

refundingNov2026.label: Quarterly Refunding statement, Nov 2026
refundingNov2026.source: Treasury press release sb0678, Quarterly Refunding Statement (Nov 4 2026)
refundingNov2026.note: Nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes kept unchanged "for the next several quarters". The 7-year note becomes a quarterly new issue (with two reopenings) from March 2027. The TGA could peak at $1.025T (±$50bn) in late November and late January.

connections._note: Figures for Part III: phrase decoder, rate corridor, crypto bridge, global dollar. All via FRED.

termPremium.label: 10-year term premium (Kim-Wright model estimate)
termPremium.source: Federal Reserve Board (Kim-Wright) via FRED THREEFYTP10
termPremium.note: A model estimate, not an observed price. Other models (e.g. the NY Fed ACM model) give different levels. It was −0.20% in Jan 2020.

dollarIndex.label: Nominal broad US dollar index
dollarIndex.source: Federal Reserve H.10 via FRED DTWEXBGS

swapLinesNow.label: Central bank liquidity swaps outstanding
swapLinesNow.source: Federal Reserve H.4.1 via FRED SWPT
